description:
YouTube
==
- feat(YouTube - Spoof streaming data): Use the YouTube API on `Mobile Web` only to get the defaut audio track id
- fix(YouTube - Player components): `Hide seek message` setting does not work when app version is spoofed
- fix(YouTube - Settings): Handle on screen back swipe gesture
- fix(YouTube - Swipe controls): Opacity is not applied to `Swipe overlay brightness color` and `Swipe overlay volume color` settings
- fix(YouTube - SponsorBlock): Opacity migration function is missing


Shared
==
- feat(Spoof streaming data): Reflects the latest changes in MediaServiceCore
- feat(Spoof streaming data): Remove `TV Simply` client, which is no longer working [yt-dlp#14456 (comment)](https://github.com/yt-dlp/yt-dlp/issues/14456#issuecomment-3339355268) [ReVanced_Extended#3197](https://github.com/inotia00/ReVanced_Extended/issues/3197)
